name: Kontar the Corrupt

facts.text: Level 65, 30,000 health, in World's End. He calls eight to ten corruptor bodyguards whose heal (200) mends any of their side; tether 2,600.
Bot chat mentions corrupt sylvan on the isle who were 'their own kin once'.

story: Kontar was a chieftain of the Sylvan of World's End, and when the titan's roots soured that country he did not leave with his people. He stayed, and drank from the soured springs, and called it strength. His corruptors are the Sylvan who stayed with him. They are healers still, the old Sylvan say with grief, the best his clan ever had, and they keep him and each other whole no matter what the realm throws at them. Kontar calls it loyalty. His kin in Domnann call it the saddest thing on the isle.
legend: His corruptor bodyguards heal everything on their side: kill the healers first, all eight to ten, then Kontar. Interrupt their heals if you can. Keep the fight near his camp or he walks home whole, and his guard is back at full strength before you are.

aggro: The roots made me strong. They can make you strong.

phases.text: Corruptors, to me! Mend your chief!

lairEntry: Sylvan in dark bark stand guard. They do not blink.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Kontar the Corrupt is fallen. His kin can mourn.
